\class BaseObject {C : CartesianPrecat} (E : C)

\class MonoidObject \extends BaseObject { | iide : Hom terminal.apex E | imul : Hom (Bprod E E) E | iide-left : imul ∘ pair (iide ∘ terminalMap) id = id | iide-right : imul ∘ pair id (iide ∘ terminalMap) = id | imul-assoc : imul ∘ prodMap imul id = imul ∘ prodMap id imul ∘ associator }
\class GroupObject \extends MonoidObject { | iinverse : Hom E E | iinverse-left : imul ∘ pair iinverse id = iide ∘ terminalMap | iinverse-right : imul ∘ pair id iinverse = iide ∘ terminalMap }
\class CMonoidObject \extends MonoidObject { | imul-comm : imul ∘ pair proj2 proj1 = imul | iide-right => comm_pair-swap imul-comm id (iide ∘ terminalMap) *> iide-left }
\lemma comm_pair-swap {C : CartesianPrecat} {E : C} {m : Hom (C.Bprod E E) E} (c : m ∘ pair proj2 proj1 = m) {z : C} (f g : Hom z E) : m ∘ pair f g = m ∘ pair g f

\lemma imul-assoc-char {C : CartesianPrecat} {E : C} {m : Hom (C.Bprod E E) E} (p : \Pi {z : C} (f g h : Hom z E) -> m ∘ pair (m ∘ pair f g) h = m ∘ pair f (m ∘ pair g h)) : m ∘ prodMap m id = m ∘ prodMap id m ∘ associator

\class AbGroupObject \extends BaseObject { | izro : Hom terminal.apex E | iadd : Hom (Bprod E E) E | inegative : Hom E E | izro-left : iadd ∘ pair (izro ∘ terminalMap) id = id | iadd-assoc : iadd ∘ prodMap iadd id = iadd ∘ prodMap id iadd ∘ associator | iadd-comm : iadd ∘ pair proj2 proj1 = iadd | inegative-left : iadd ∘ pair inegative id = izro ∘ terminalMap }
\class CRingObject \extends AbGroupObject, CMonoidObject { | ildistr : imul ∘ prodMap id iadd = iadd ∘ prodMap imul imul ∘ pair (prodMap id proj1) (prodMap id proj2) }
\func homMonoid {C : CartesianPrecat} (X : C) (G : MonoidObject {C}) : Monoid (Hom X G.E)
\func homGroup {C : CartesianPrecat} (X : C) (G : GroupObject {C}) : Group (Hom X G.E)
\lemma imul_o {C : CartesianPrecat} (G : MonoidObject {C}) {X Y : C} (h : Hom X Y) {f g : Hom Y G.E} : G.imul ∘ pair f g ∘ h = G.imul ∘ pair (f ∘ h) (g ∘ h)
\func precompMonoidHom {C : CartesianPrecat} (G : MonoidObject {C}) {X Y : C} (h : Hom X Y) : MonoidHom (homMonoid Y G) (homMonoid X G)
\func precompHom {C : CartesianPrecat} (G : GroupObject {C}) {X Y : C} (h : Hom X Y) : GroupHom (homGroup Y G) (homGroup X G)
\func postcompHom {C : CartesianPrecat} {G H : GroupObject {C}} (a : MonoidObjectHom G H) (X : C) : GroupHom (homGroup X G) (homGroup X H)
\lemma monHom-iinverse {C : CartesianPrecat} {G H : GroupObject {C}} (a : MonoidObjectHom G H) : a.f ∘ G.iinverse = H.iinverse ∘ a.f

\record MonoidObjectHom {C : CartesianPrecat} (Dom : MonoidObject {C}) (Cod : MonoidObject {C}) (\coerce f : Hom Dom.E Cod.E) { | func-iide : f ∘ Dom.iide = Cod.iide | func-imul : f ∘ Dom.imul = Cod.imul ∘ prodMap f f }
\lemma MonoidObjectHom-char {C : CartesianPrecat} {G H : MonoidObject {C}} {f : Hom G.E H.E} : MonoidObjectHom G H f <-> (\Pi {X : C} -> MonoidHom (homMonoid X G) (homMonoid X H) (f ∘))
\instance MonoidObjectPrecat {C : CartesianPrecat} : Precat (MonoidObject {C})
\instance GroupObjectPrecat {C : CartesianPrecat} : Precat (GroupObject {C})
\func mapMonoidObject {C D : CartesianPrecat} (F : Functor C D) (pt : PreservesTerminal F) (pb : PreservesBprod F) (G : MonoidObject {C}) : MonoidObject {D} (F G.E)
\func mapGroupObject {C D : CartesianPrecat} (F : Functor C D) (pt : PreservesTerminal F) (pb : PreservesBprod F) (G : GroupObject {C}) : GroupObject {D} (F G.E)

\func mapHomGroup {C D : CartesianPrecat} (F : Functor C D) (pt : PreservesTerminal F) (pb : PreservesBprod F) (X : C) (G : GroupObject {C}) : GroupHom (homGroup X G) (homGroup (F X) (mapGroupObject F pt pb G))

\lemma mapMonoidObjectHom {C D : CartesianPrecat} (F : Functor C D) (pt : PreservesTerminal F) (pb : PreservesBprod F) {G H : MonoidObject {C}} (a : MonoidObjectHom G H) : MonoidObjectHom (mapMonoidObject F pt pb G) (mapMonoidObject F pt pb H) (F.Func a)

\lemma mapMonoidObject-natural {C D : CartesianPrecat} {F F' : Functor C D} (a : NatTrans F F') (pt : PreservesTerminal F) (pb : PreservesBprod F) (pt' : PreservesTerminal F') (pb' : PreservesBprod F') (G : MonoidObject {C}) : MonoidObjectHom (mapMonoidObject F pt pb G) (mapMonoidObject F' pt' pb' G) (a G.E)

\lemma mapMonoidObject-comp {C D B : CartesianPrecat} {F : Functor C D} {G : Functor D B} (ptF : PreservesTerminal F) (pbF : PreservesBprod F) (ptG : PreservesTerminal G) (pbG : PreservesBprod G) (pt : PreservesTerminal (Comp G F)) (pb : PreservesBprod (Comp G F)) (X : MonoidObject {C}) : MonoidObjectHom (mapMonoidObject (Comp G F) pt pb X) (mapMonoidObject G ptG pbG (mapMonoidObject F ptF pbF X)) B.id
